name: impeccable
description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
one_liner: Gives your AI coding tool a vocabulary of design commands (like 'make it bolder' or 'polish this') and a built-in critic that catches generic, cookie-cutter-looking pages before you ship them.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small agency that builds client sites with AI help and keeps getting called out for every project looking like the same generic template.
business_use_cases: A freelance designer-developer runs `/impeccable audit` on every client project before delivery as a built-in quality gate, charging a 'polish pass' as a line item.
A no-code/low-code agency standardizes it across all AI-assisted builds so client sites stop looking like obvious AI output (purple gradients, generic cards).
A SaaS startup's single engineer uses `critique` and `harden` to get a professional-looking UI without hiring a designer for the MVP.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI slop removal' audit service for startups that already shipped an AI-built site and know it looks generic.
Package it into a productized weekly retainer: run audits and polish passes on a client's site as it evolves.

steal_this: Offer a $200 'AI Slop Audit' this weekend: run `/impeccable audit` and `critique` against any startup's live site, send them the ranked findings as a free teaser report, then sell the fix.
